sentences.text: Ross was using Thomson Reuters’s headnotes as AI data to create a legal research tool to compete with Westlaw.
sentences.rationale: 交代Ross使用Thomson Reuters判例提要作为AI数据以构建竞品法律检索工具的事实

sentences.text: It is undisputed that Ross’s AI is not generative AI (AI that writes new content itself).
sentences.rationale: 交代双方无争议的事实：Ross的AI并非可自行撰写新内容的生成式AI

sentences.text: Weighing them all together, I grant summary judgment for Thomson Reuters on fair use.
sentences.rationale: 法院综合权衡合理使用各项因素后，就合理使用问题支持Thomson Reuters的简易判决

sentences.text: Because the AI landscape is changing rapidly, I note for readers that only non-generative AI is before me today.
sentences.rationale: 法官向读者作出适用射程说明：鉴于AI格局变化迅速，本案仅涉及非生成式AI
